topics.name: Studio Everyday
topics.purpose: Define Everyday as a Studio composition area for ordinary practical tools such as shopping/list views, using the same Lens/MetaModule composition rules as strategic/analytical surfaces.

semantics.rule: Everyday is not a separate runtime or semantic primitive.
semantics.composition_rule: Everyday views/functions compose existing canonical modules/data sources.
semantics.shop_rule: Shopping/list semantics remain owned by #SHOP while Everyday/Studio projects them.
semantics.reuse_rule: Everyday uses the same Web Base, localization, style and Lens mechanisms as other Studio content.
semantics.authority_rule: Everyday placement does not grant data/operation authority.
semantics.naming_rule: UI may present Everyday as a Studio section/category only.

invariants.rule: Studio and Lens compose and project existing canonical semantics; analysis, presets and visualizations never silently become source semantic authority.
